bio.text: Jack Reed was elected U.S. Senator from Rhode Island in 1996, after serving three terms in the Rhode Island State Senate and three terms in the U.S. House, to which he was first elected in 1990.
A Cranston native, he graduated from West Point in 1971, served in the 82nd Airborne Division and taught at the academy, and left the Army Reserves in 1991 as a Major.
He earned a master's degree in public policy from Harvard's Kennedy School and a law degree from Harvard Law School in 1982.
